---
title: react-tailwind
description: React 19 client with Tailwind CSS v4.
---

Branch: `template/react-tailwind` — the default React client plus the
Tailwind CSS v4 pipeline.

- `src/client/tailwind.css` — input file: `@import "tailwindcss"`, dark mode
  mapped to `[data-theme="dark"]`, existing CSS variables bridged to theme
  tokens (`@theme inline`).
- `buildClientAssets()` runs `@tailwindcss/cli` before `Bun.build` — no
  PostCSS needed.
- `app.tsx` imports `.tailwind.css` before `styles.css` so custom CSS wins
  the cascade.
- `bun run dev:css` watches the Tailwind input.

Existing components keep working — custom CSS is unlayered and wins over
Tailwind utilities, so Tailwind classes are purely additive.

```bash
bunx create-dulak my-app --template react-tailwind
```
